no_tempo_analyzer.title: AX BPM: no local tempo analyzer available
no_tempo_analyzer.description:
AX BPM is tracking {entry_title}. Deezer metadata covers most tracks, but tracks where Deezer reports bpm: 0 need local audio analysis. No audio decoder is available for the built-in NumPy tempo estimator, so those tracks will resolve to unknown.

To fix: install one of the supported decoders (miniaudio, soundfile, or an ffmpeg binary) in the Home Assistant environment, or install the AX-BPM Sidecar add-on for aubio-grade accuracy.

user.title: AX BPM Configuration
user.description: Track the tempo (BPM) of the currently playing media. All network requests are anonymous — no API key required. {sidecar_status}

data_description.octave_disambiguation: Correct beat-tracker octave errors. 'Genre + mood' needs the AX BPM sidecar add-on; it degrades to genre-only when the sidecar is unreachable.
data_description.mood_analyzer_url: Leave empty to auto-detect the sidecar (add-on hostname, then homeassistant.local:8099). The sidecar provides aubio-grade tempo + mood analysis.
data_description.mood_api_token: Shared secret set in the AX-BPM Sidecar add-on options. Sent as a Bearer token on /analyze only. Leave empty if the add-on has no token set.
